C01.evidence: Local public9b baseline, development. capability_check accepts daily scheduled email intent. First raw requirements candidate contains daily/Asia-Seoul/09:00 plus report-scope and recipient questions, but it is not the accepted ledger: the second raw candidate and parsed requirements contain tasks=[] with one source-only unresolved paragraph; first public draft.schedule is null. Therefore no structured schedule slots are credited as accepted. The sole displayed question asks the source, mentions internal schedule enums and resource ID/file path, and does not ask the missing recipient or report scope. It restates 09:00 without asking it again. CLARIFY is correct, but necessary-question recall is 1/3 and schedule preservation is unproven in the accepted state. No workflow or external execution.
